channel.title: Nick McCarty
channel.description: Data science, ML/AI, computer vision, and agentic systems — by Nick McCarty.

item.title: Cost Envelope Management for Production AI Agents
item.description: Token budgets, VRAM residency, auto-throttling, and hierarchical cost attribution — what 239 logged runs reveal about where an agent's costs actually accumulate, and the envelope that contains them.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Layer 4 Circuit Diagram
item.description: Interactive visualization of the ResNet Layer 4 co-activation circuit extracted from a fine-tuned Faster R-CNN pot detector.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Economic Data Tools: FRED and BEA
item.description: fred_tool: theme-routed FRED API with rate limiting, [FRED:SERIES:DATE] citations. bea_tool: curated query catalogue over NIPA, Regional, GDPbyIndustry, ITA with [BEA:...] citations.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Wiggum Panel: Three-Persona Parallel Evaluation
item.description: Three evaluator personas running in parallel threads, each reviewing from a distinct angle. Their issues are deduplicated and merged into Wiggum's revision context before the first rewrite.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Closing the SkillOpt Gaps: What Actually Shipped
item.description: Three gaps between the harness autoresearch loop and SkillOpt: validation gating shipped as _validate_proposal(), the global exit became Kimi unblocking, and the epoch structure and skill artifact remain open.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Plugin System: /forge:plugin and /forge:list
item.description: /forge:plugin: LLM generates plugin JSON spec, files written to plugins/<name>/, hot-loaded into skills.REGISTRY. /forge:list: grouped command listing. Plugin skills auto-inject into synthesis; commands invoked as /plugin:command.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Interview Skills: /grill-me and /onboarding
item.description: /grill-me: saturation-gated interview loop (3-8 rounds, novelty threshold 3/10, fatigue detector) producing a structured knowledge brief. /onboarding: fixed 3-round scaffold + free-form grill-me + TOML config + ChromaDB memory seed.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Developer Utility Skills: /scratchpad and /test-harness
item.description: /scratchpad: force tool loop + exact-values synthesis instruction + prior result injection. /test-harness: run fast/full pytest suite, save output, parse summary.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Trading Skills: /validate-trades and /execute-trades
item.description: /validate-trades: deterministic PASS/WARN/FLAG checks on each thesis using local TA signals. /execute-trades: bracket order construction from validated theses, dry-run by default, --live submits to Alpaca.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Circuit Extraction Notebook
item.description: Executable notebook for the circuit extraction pipeline: model loading, ablation over 2048 layer4 channels, co-activation graph construction, and Plotly visualization.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Diagnostic Skills: /debug and /troubleshoot
item.description: /debug: last 2 ERROR/FAIL runs, trace events, source anchors, structured Diagnosis/Evidence/Fix. /troubleshoot: debug + suggest in one call, Issue/Root cause/Fix/Next task.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Site Generation Skills: /design and /build-page
item.description: /design: Playwright CSS extraction + vision screenshot analysis + 10-section design system. /build-page: three-pass generation — cluster analysis, HTML shell, per-file card injection with optional visual refinement loop.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Site Generation Skills: /site and /deck
item.description: /site = /design + /build-page in one command. /deck generates a themed .pptx using python-pptx with colors and fonts extracted from the design system.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Navigation Skills: /suggest and /re-orient
item.description: /suggest: next-task recommendation from orientation + runs + git log + autoresearch state. /re-orient: fast project snapshot combining orientation cache with live GitHub data fetched in parallel.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Explorer View: Per-Run Pipeline DAG Inspector
item.description: Per-run pipeline DAG with clickable node inspector — task metadata, memory hits, planned queries, search tool calls, synthesis tokens, Wiggum dimension bars, evaluator reasoning, and RLHF feedback per stage.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Page Feedback Widget: Closing the Loop Between Browser and Agent
item.description: Chrome extension + FastAPI endpoint: leave notes on any local page, agents read them from page_feedback.jsonl. Shadow DOM widget with badge counter, completion checklist, and one-click clear.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Pipeline View: Data Enrichment DAG
item.description: Static SVG DAG showing how web search, Beige Book, FRED, BEA, Market Signals, yfinance, and Alpaca feed a context merge before LLM synthesis and Wiggum evaluation. Conditional dashed edge for trading thesis Alpaca order execution.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Research History View: A Unified Activity Log
item.description: Every search query, browser visit, and research output in one timeline. Filterable by type (search / browser / research) and time window, with score bars and direct links to the Memory store.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: inference.py: The Unified LLM Backend Shim
item.description: Drop-in `import inference as ollama` replacement that routes to Ollama, vLLM, llama-server, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. 14-model name translation map, per-model HARNESS_ENDPOINTS registry, OllamaLike adapter, real wall-clock TTFT timing.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: harness/api: The FastAPI Backend and Dashboard Server
item.description: Async-native FastAPI server with modular routers, WebSocket live streaming, static dashboard serving, and auto OpenAPI docs. The async replacement for the old Flask server.py.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Skills Registry: Hook Points, Auto-Activation, and 38 Skills
item.description: Six hook points, seven auto-activation predicates, lazy loading, and 38 skills: deep, cite, panel, knowledge-graph, annotate, recall, queue, orientation, introspect, contextualize, sync-wiki, playwright, re-orient, debug, suggest, troubleshoot, transcribe, design, build-page, deck, and more.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Inside agent.py: The Three-Turn Research Pipeline
item.description: Three turns: vision preprocessing + search, synthesis written to disk, Wiggum evaluation loop. Plus novelty gating, keep_alive estimation from run history, thinking-model detection, and the SYNTH_INSTRUCTION autoresearch target.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Position Swap: Beige Book RAG Results and the DPO Cold-Start Problem
item.description: Prepending Beige Book context hurt by 0.08; appending helped by 0.13. A falsified hypothesis and what the position swap reveals about training signal for domain-grounded synthesis.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Building the Detectors: What Actually Shipped After 107 Experiments
item.description: What the four proposed convergence detectors became in actual implementation — regex over cosine similarity, Kimi unblocking over a hard stop, and a pre-proposal research phase that wasn't in the design.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Live Data Beats Narrative: FRED RAG Experiment Results
item.description: FRED fred_end: +0.40 vs control. Beige Book rag_end was +0.13. Live quantitative series is 3× more useful than qualitative Fed prose for grounded economic synthesis.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Memory as Infrastructure: Quality-Weighted Retrieval and the Ontology Graph
item.description: How the harness memory layer turns isolated run output into retrieval signal: dual-store architecture, quality-weighted ranking, RLHF feedback loops, and UMAP-based topic visualization.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: OSINT Enrichment: Nine Layers of Passive Reconnaissance
item.description: Nine-layer OSINT pipeline wired directly into the harness research loop. Zero-config baseline covers DNS, HTTP headers, RDAP, crt.sh, Wayback, and Shodan. Two key-gated layers add tech stack and threat intel.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Planner: Two-Pass Pre-Research Analysis
item.description: Two LLM calls before research starts: a prior knowledge pass (what do I already know? what gaps need search?) and a main plan pass (task_type, complexity, expected_sections, targeted queries). Plan output is injected into synthesis as context.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Search Cache: SQLite TTL Caching for DDGS Queries and Research Contexts
item.description: Two-table SQLite cache: search_cache for per-query DDGS results (always active), research_cache for full research contexts (opt-in via RESEARCH_CACHE=1 for autoresearch). SHA-256 keys, lazy expiry, schema migration.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Deploying the Harness with Docker: CPU, GPU, and Compose Variants
item.description: CPU and GPU Dockerfiles plus a three-service Compose stack (vLLM for large models, Ollama for fast models, harness dashboard) with health checks, live code mounts, and GPU passthrough.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The GitHub Skill: LLM-Assisted Git Operations from the Agent Loop
item.description: 12 GitHub operations auto-detected from task strings, with LLM-generated commit messages, PR titles/bodies, and issue descriptions — invokable directly from the harness agent loop.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Subagent Demo Suite: Orchestrating Multi-Task Research Portfolios
item.description: subagent_demo.py and subagent_demo_v2.py show sequential and parallel multi-task orchestration — Flask queue for one-at-a-time throughput, MCP HTTP server for concurrent execution up to MCP_MAX_CONCURRENCY.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Synthetic Eval Task Generation with TinyTroupe Personas
item.description: Eight practitioner personas generate diverse research tasks via Microsoft TinyTroupe (or raw Ollama fallback). Criteria are auto-derived from the task text — count detection, structural requirements, no placeholder checks.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Email Skill: Personalized Outreach Drafts from Conference Speaker CSVs
item.description: Two LLM calls per contact — subject line and body — with slide content fetched via MarkItDown, per-contact JSON output, a manifest file, and every draft logged to runs.jsonl as task_type email_draft.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Lit-Review Skill: Seven Steps from ArXiv Query to Rendered Survey
item.description: Seven steps: ArXiv fetch → Semantic Scholar enrichment → persona curation → per-paper annotation with Wiggum → LLM clustering → cross-cluster synthesis → Jinja2 render. Three output templates: survey, gaps, executive.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Mining a Ground-Truth Knowledge Base for the Eval Suite
item.description: Five eval tasks, five deep research runs with the novelty gate disabled, authoritative documents saved to knowledge_base/ and injected as file_context when the eval suite runs those tasks.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Wiki Sync Skill: Deterministic Source Extraction and Gap-Targeted Code Injection
item.description: Regular sync extracts constants, model names, and Wiggum weights from six source files via regex. Gap-targeted sync matches Wiggum FAIL issues to trigger keywords and injects relevant function bodies into the wiki.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Agentic System Design Patterns
item.description: 27 named design patterns for agentic LLM systems — from Inference Shim and Novelty Gate to DAG Orchestrator, Injection Scanner, and Data Flywheel.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Agentic Threat Hardening: The OWASP Top 10, Applied
item.description: OWASP's ASI Top 10 maps ten attack classes that emerge when LLMs gain tools, memory, and autonomy — audited against the harness and translated into concrete mitigations.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: When the Loop Defeats Itself: Convergence Failures in Autonomous Prompt Optimization
item.description: Three nested failure modes exposed by 90 experiments that never beat their own baseline — corrupted diagnostic, baseline contamination, and a self-defeating ban list — and four convergence detectors.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Regression Harness: Eval Suite, Criterion Functions, and Experimental Infrastructure
item.description: Nine tasks, eleven criterion functions, one composite score, and three epistemically distinct personas — the measurement infrastructure that turns informal intuition about output quality into machine-checkable gates.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Leverage: What the Metric Measures, What It Doesn't, and Why the Replacement Framing Gets the Math Wrong
item.description: A quantitative look at the harness leverage metric and why the corporate narrative of AI 'replacing lower-value human capital' misreads what the math actually shows.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Playwright Skill: LLM-Guided Navigation via ARIA Snapshots
item.description: ARIA snapshots not DOM, sitemap-based pre-planning, a saturation completeness oracle, detached browser persistence, and 12 steps of LLM-driven navigation with blocked-click memory.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: SBOM and AIBOM for Agentic Systems
item.description: A traditional SBOM lists Python packages. An AIBOM lists the AI models — and surfaces cloud endpoints that pip freeze will never show you.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: What SkillOpt Gets Right
item.description: Microsoft's SkillOpt formalizes three design choices our autoresearch loop lacks: proactive validation gating, a fast/slow epoch structure, and a persistent skill artifact.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: YouTube and Media Transcription: Two Paths, One Research Input
item.description: Auto-captions first (no download), pytubefix + Whisper fallback for YouTube; ffmpeg extraction for direct media URLs. WHISPER_MODEL and WHISPER_DEVICE env vars, imageio_ffmpeg bundled binary.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Five Personas, One Veto: Consensus Filtering for Fine-Tuning Data
item.description: curator.py runs each annotated paper through five LLM personas — Pragmatic Engineer, Academic Rigorist, Synthesis Thinker, Contrarian, Newcomer — gating inclusion with a dual threshold: consensus mean and individual veto floor.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: Seven Principles and a Moving Frontier: The Harness Roadmap
item.description: The goals that stayed constant, the milestones that multiplied, and what three rounds of roadmap revision reveal about building self-improving systems.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The op CLI: A Rich REPL for the Research Harness
item.description: op is the terminal-first entry point to the harness: an interactive REPL with persistent history, eight slash commands, browser flags, and a pyfiglet splash screen rendered in isometric ASCII.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)

item.title: The Supervisor: Four Convergence Signals and Advisory Interventions
item.description: supervisor.py monitors the harness pipeline for convergence collapse across four signals — score variance, output size CV, search utilization, and content similarity — and recommends specific interventions when thresholds are crossed.
item.author: nickmccarty0@gmail.com (Nick McCarty)
